title: Cookie Banner
body: As a first time anonymous user, I want to see a banner with a disclaimer about cookies and tracking with the option to opt out of most tracking, so that I can be informed about cookies and other tracking done by MassEnergize and choose to keep my data private.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
making this priority 1.
We should perhaps confer with our lawyer so we get it right. Or copy from others.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: This is the first version: Changes requested: 1. Once closed, the banner needs to go away and not be shown again. This could be done with a cookie or with localStorage. Potentially also the back end could record that it was seen and dismissed (for regulatory compliance); 2. The text should be changed [@kaatvds please give feedback]; This website uses cookies to provide the best user experience we can. We share no data with third parties or for any commercial purpose. By using this site, you accept this use of cookies as outlined in our data privacy policy. 3. The button that says "Cookie Policy" should say "Data Privacy Policy"

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
I've written to lawyer. Will report back when I hear back.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
When the "Data Privacy Policy" button is clicked, policy should show in a new tab.
Also, the link to the policy shouldn't be hardcoded, but should be formed from the site URL + /policies?policy=Privacy%20Policy
Otherwise the user is taken to a different communities site.  The policies are all the same (on the prod site), though in principle they could be different in different places.
